subject: Neptune Analytics POC: post-call recap & timeline options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jordan <claire.jordan@neptune-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Neptune Analytics POC: post-call recap & timeline options

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick written recap and two pilot timeline options so we can lock dates and owners. Please confirm which option you prefer and any additional acceptance criteria.

High-level goal
- Validate Redwood inference integration for Neptune Analytics’ customer support summarization pipeline and measure latency/cost tradeoffs for 10–20 concurrent producer flows.

Proposed success criteria (initial)
- Accuracy: summary-level ROUGE/L2 alignment on pilot prompt set >= 0.75 relative to Neptune baseline sampling (we'll provide reference prompts).
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for typical 512-token sessions.
- Cost: per-call token cost reduction target of 20% vs current hosted vendor for equivalent quality.
- Stability: zero-severity outages during business hours for the pilot period.

Evaluation plan & artifacts
- Redwood will run a side-by-side runbook using a shared prompt set (we provide).
- Weekly readouts with sample outputs, token/cost breakdown, and regression checks.
- Final readout includes a technical runbook, ops checklist, and recommendations on quantization/profile.

Owners (initial proposal)
- Redwood: Evelyn Hart (overall lead / kickoff facilitate), Marissa Cole (POC coordination & readouts), Karthik Iyer (infra & integration).
- Neptune: Claire Jordan (product sponsor), Tom Nguyen (SRE contact).

Timeline options (pick one)
1) Rapid 4-week pilot (recommended)
   - Kickoff: Mar 29
   - Week 1: baseline runs + integration (prefix caching setup)
   - Week 2: throughput tuning + latency SLOs
   - Week 3: edge-case prompts + quality checks
   - Week 4: consolidation + final readout (Apr 26)

2) Extended 8-week pilot (if deeper integration / on-prem testing needed)
   - Kickoff: Mar 29 or Apr 5, with extra integration sprints and an interim architecture review at week 4.

Immediate next steps
1) Confirm timeline option and kickoff date (Mar 29 preferred by Redwood).
2) Neptune to share initial prompt set and a small sample dataset (anonymized) for evaluation.
3) Exchange security/contact points; Neptune to indicate required evidence (SOC2, data residency).
4) Redwood to send kickoff agenda + calendar invite once dates are confirmed.

Attachments: neptune-poc-outline.pdf (overview + roles), Neptune-SecurityQ.pdf (security questions).

Thanks — ready to lock dates once you confirm.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Claire Jordan <claire.jordan@neptune-analytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Neptune Analytics POC: post-call recap & timeline options

Thanks Eve — good notes. We prefer the rapid 4-week pilot and March 29 kickoff works for our team. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: we need to confirm that any logs/samples you store for debugging during the pilot reside in the US-only region. Can you confirm?
- Additional success metric: control for hallucination rate on our customer-name entities (company-sensitive) — target < 1% hallucination over the prompt set.

I'll upload a short redacted sample dataset and our security questionnaire to the Drive folder by COB Friday.

Claire
Claire Jordan
Head of Product | Neptune Analytics
claire.jordan@neptune-analytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Neptune Analytics POC: post-call recap & timeline options

Great — locking in the rapid 4-week flow as preferred. I've sketched owners and a lightweight cadence so we can move quickly. Notes below and attaching a simple roles file (poc-roles.csv).

Proposed owner map and deliverables
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, by Mar 26): Neptune provides redacted prompt set + security questionnaire. (Owner: Claire)
- Week 1 (Mar 29-Apr 2): Integration + baseline runs (Owner: Karthik)
- Week 2 (Apr 5-Apr 9): Performance tuning, batching and caching config (Owner: Karthik)
- Week 3 (Apr 12-Apr 16): Edge-case tests and sample comparisons (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 4 (Apr 19-Apr 26): Consolidation and final readout prep (Owner: Marissa / Evelyn)

Cadence
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays at 11:00 AM PST (30 min) — quick demo + blockers.
- Mid-week async updates in the shared Drive doc; we will capture token/cost tables and sample outputs.

Acceptance metrics (operational)
- Weekly pass/fail checklist tied to success criteria; any regression triggers a hotfix sprint.

I will draft the kickoff agenda and send a calendar invite once Eve confirms the time slots.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks — locking in kickoff for Monday, Mar 29 at 10:00 AM PST. I just sent the calendar invite (please accept).

Kickoff logistics
- Kickoff: Mon Mar 29, 10:00–11:00 AM PST (Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321)
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays 11:00–11:30 AM PST, recurring through Apr 30
- Final readout: Tue Apr 26, 9:00–10:00 AM PST

Drive folder and artifacts
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NeptunePOC

Attachments: kickoff-agenda.docx

Looking forward to getting started. I'll lead the kickoff and Marissa will run the weekly readouts. Karthik will own infra and config changes.

Best,
Evelyn

Claire
